column1: # legacy-grace-allowlist.tsv -- packs allowed to ship WITHOUT contract_version (DGN-1498).
# compat-lint.sh grants legacy-grace (C4/C5/C6 skipped) ONLY to a manifest whose
# (name, reference_slug) identity is listed here; any other manifest without
# contract_version is a C1 FAIL. The list exists to preserve the status quo for
# pre-v2 packs -- it is closed: add a row only for a pack that already shipped
# before DGN-1498, never for a new pack (a new pack declares contract_version).
# Merging a branch that brings a pack without contract_version (e.g. packs/dev on
# dgn-939-inplace-engine) needs an explicit row decision at merge time.
